description: The plan marks 4.37 closed while the four Not Evaluated rows and the two limits of 1.3.5 and 2.2.2 keep citing it. A limit that has gone is a level to raise, not a citation to keep; the report would otherwise understate the library on the day it improved. The case used to be written over 4.8 — until that finding really did close, the two rows leaning on it were raised, and the control it left behind stopped failing.
